responsibility: Declares the analyzer’s call-summary abstraction and replay machinery for interprocedural summarization. A call_summary captures one analyzed function outcome from an exploded node, while call_summary_replay owns the cross-context remapping logic that translates summary-frame parameters, regions, svalues, and bindings into caller-side equivalents before applying the summarized state changes.
same_name_distinction: Defines the summary and replay class interfaces and mapping caches used for interprocedural summarization, while call-summary.cc supplies the actual replay and description logic.
